segment.source: Renders two or three panels that split readers by how they want to buy: start on your own, talk to sales, or go through a partner. Each panel names who it is for, what happens next, and links onward. Use it for: the foot of a pricing page, a B2B homepage, an onboarding hub, a page serving both a card payment and a procurement process. Prefer 'Contact Options Grid' when every route is a support channel rather than a way to buy, and 'Plan Chooser' when the split is by audience.
